name: api-versioning-strategy
description: Select an API versioning strategy: URL path (v1/), header (Accept / custom), media type (application/vnd+json), query param, or evolutionary (no versioning + additive). Per style: when-to-use / trade-offs / client ergonomics. Breaking vs non-breaking change taxonomy. Deprecation policy with Sunset + Deprecation headers (RFC 8594 / draft), parallel-version windows, migration docs, consumer communication. Applies to REST / GraphQL / gRPC / event schemas. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
